issues.title: Acceptance permits hand-written verification claims without real CPU/CUDA/migration proof
issues.description: The acceptance gate checks a few scalar claims and report/artifact hashes, but does not require the independent verifier protocol/schema, checks, checked_files_sha256, verification_script identity/text, reproduced metrics/groups, or migration calibration comparison. Hashing a hand-written JSON does not establish those checks ran.
issues.minimal_proof: The /tmp reproducer creates genuine 40 train / 40 validation synthetic smoke artifacts for two CPU-only recalibrations, relabels only one report environment.device to cuda, and writes six-field CPU/CUDA proofs plus a five-field CPU-transfer proof. All artifact SHA256 tables are correct. _acceptance returns successfully although no independent verifier or CUDA/migration execution ran. Neither producer methods nor loader are mocked.
issues.impact: register_experiment and validate_registration use this gate to authorize full execution, so the required real 40/40 CPU/CUDA plus migration acceptance contract is bypassed.
issues.recommendation: Validate the actual independent verifier proof schema, required checks, source/evidence identity and recomputed results for both smoke runs and migration; reject stripped claim-only proofs.

issues.title: Failed or running acceptance evidence remains eligible for registration
issues.description: Acceptance and checksum-table readers do not inspect failure.json or running.marker beside acceptance/proof evidence; only recalibrated run directories have this guard.
issues.minimal_proof: Using the same valid hashed fixture acceptance, create evidence/failure.json beside evidence/acceptance.json and the proofs: _acceptance still returns verified. Replace it with evidence/running.marker: the gate still returns verified. Changing markers does not alter any bound artifact.
issues.impact: Retained success JSON from a failed or unfinished acceptance publication can authorize registration despite its authoritative state marker.
issues.recommendation: Apply read-only failed/running evidence checks to acceptance, proof and registry paths (including containing evidence directories), while retaining the runner output marker exception needed for its own final validation.
